scope: Author Yehu Chen repository snapshots and documented transformation; feasibility of a separate candidate-level 2012/2016/2018 labeled cohort for a 2020 replay. Descriptive only: no fit, admission, forecast or owner-worktree changes.

decision.reason: Rows and internal candidate outcome labels exist, but source tables lack unique poll/question/sample identifiers, exact dates, question/mode/population and source URLs. Exact Tierney content matches imply overlap risk, especially 2012.

readme_2020.claims: Describes historical polling and 2020 forecast; README says MIT and points to LICENSE.
readme_2020.rights_check: Raw root LICENSE URL at this commit returned 404; inspected commit tree had no root LICENSE; GitHub repository API returned license=null. Third-party data rights not established.

chen_article.title: Polls, Context, and Time: A Dynamic Hierarchical Bayesian Forecasting Model for US Senate Elections
chen_article.collection_lineage: Paper states Senate poll data came from FiveThirtyEight and CNN, thanks Harry Enten at CNN for data, and links Code Ocean / Harvard Dataverse replication materials.

tierney_article.title: Bias and Excess Variance in Election Polling: A Not-So-Hidden Markov Model
tierney_article.collection_lineage: Tierney and Volfovsky describe reliance on Chen et al. Senate polling data; this is collection-level lineage, not row-to-poll ID identity.

chen_2019_combined.status_at_commit: renamed from CNNData1992to2018.csv; unchanged file content in that commit

chen_2019_cnn_data.schema: Same 10 fields as 2019 combined historical table; no poll/question/sample ID.

chen_2019_standalone_2018.projection_check: Its 2018 rows are identical in order to the combined 2019 source across all 10 shared substantive fields; it is duplicate representation, not additional records.

chen_2021_standalone_2018.target_timing: After 2020 election, before 2022 target by Git commit metadata only; not admissible as 2020 as-of bytes.

pairable_candidate_rows.rule: Restrict to 2012/2016/2018 and nonpositive daysLeft; pair exactly one row flagged Democrat with exactly one row flagged Republican in group; report a pair only when both outcome labels are numeric. A group can still combine separate surveys because the table has no poll/question/sample IDs.

outcome_label_check.scope_caveat: Internal consistency only; outcome values were not independently verified against certified state returns.

tierney_overlap_screen.method: Coarse exact state/cycle/day/pollster key; exact candidate D/R support values; one D/R source pair with matching Chen source N. Does not require Chen source N to equal Tierney reported_n and has no poll/sample ID.
tierney_overlap_screen.interpretation: Strong overlap risk, especially 2012; candidate-content matches suggest common source rows but cannot prove physical poll identity. Nonmatches are not proven distinct because date semantics/transforms differ.

observed_transformations: 2020 script reads live FiveThirtyEight Senate poll CSV for 2018/2020 output; it does not reproduce 2019 legacy combined table.
numberSupport is floor(samplesize*pct/100), so reconstructed support values from rounded percentages are not raw counts.
daysLeft comment says poll end date relative to election, but code uses negative inclusive date_range(start_date,election_date); actual dates are then dropped.
Before dropping poll_id/question_id, script filters candidate/question variants and population combinations; IDs are absent from final CSV.
For 2018, samplesize is reassigned to sum of candidate numberSupport values within question_id; resulting N may be effective support total, not respondent N.
2021 script revision includes a Mississippi Senate candidate identifier remapping and other filtering/recoding changes; 2019 vs 2021 row-count differences are not evidence of improvement.
author_generator.legacy_transform_limit: The 2019 combined 1992-2018 data are not regenerated/documented by these scripts. Do not project 2020/2021 transformations onto the older CSV as established lineage.

target_safety.2020: 2019 combined commit is dated 2019-11-20 and contains no 2020 cycle rows; chronological pretarget candidate status only, no independent exact-availability or public-retrieval proof. 2021 snapshot is posttarget and cannot support 2020 as-of use.
target_safety.2022: Both 2019 and 2021 commit timestamps are pre-2022; 2021 file only has 2018 polls. This is chronology, not proof of historical availability or identity.
target_safety.2018: Its own outcome labels cannot be used as predictors for 2018; only prior cycles are target-safe for a 2018 forecast.

source_captures: New local raw captures and author script/README captures are stored only in this directory. Existing standalone 2019/2021 CSV captures are referenced by path/hash and were not recopied. No raw source data was committed to public repo.
